nonClaims: numeric Depth safety at antialiased or mixed-object boundary pixels
motion blur, transparency or depth-of-field generalization

cryptomatte.thresholdRationale: The worst pixel is bounded to one 8-bit alpha code, 99 percent of pixels to one 10-bit alpha code, and whole-frame RMSE to one 12-bit alpha code.

depth.thresholdRationale: Stable non-transition surfaces are bounded to 1 mm at p99 and 1 cm worst-case; foreground/background topology must remain exact. Numeric edge depth is not compared where parent Cryptomatte coverage is below 0.999.
